ownerApproval.scope: Local implementation of homepage sample refreshes and location previews
ownerApproval.planningBasis: Up to one fresh sample attempt per rolling 24 hours in each of three selectable regions, at a conservative planning allowance of $0.10 per full scan; existing infrastructure and retention

refreshRules.reuseScope: Canonical eligible completed public scans of the exact URL and selected region
refreshRules.inFlightBehavior: Open the existing same-target, same-region public scan
refreshRules.duplicateProtection: Nonblocking PostgreSQL session lock per region; writer reads under the lock
refreshRules.lookupFailureBehavior: Return an error without starting a scan

locationRules.signedInWithoutLoc: Preserve the existing static sample destination

browserCases: Recent and fresh sample navigation using local API fixtures
